Commentary.Commentary: It's an excellent pitch for batting. The bounce is true and stroke making is not difficult. The Kiwi spinners did a good job and there was some turn on offer for them. It's often said that if Pakistan manage a good total on the board, they have the bowling to defend it. Today, they have 262 in the wallet, will their bowlers prove that saying correct? Batting under lights is always considered to be tricky. Can go both ways. Do join us in a short while to find out which way the chase goes...

Although the Kiwi bowlers gave away some free runs towards the end, they will be pleased with their overall effort. The hosts started very well and just when the pair of Haris Sohail and Fakhar Zaman got going, Kane Williamson introduced himself and Mitchell Santner in the middle overs. The spin twin bowled some tidy overs to dry up the runs which created pressure and in return fetched wickets. Apart from them, Tim Southee also impressed with his 3-wicket haul, while Trent Boult had a rare bad day at work.

It was an interesting decision by Sarfraz Ahmed to bat first under slightly overcast conditions. Pakistan soon found themselves in trouble after losing a couple of early wickets but then the 86-run partnership between Haris Sohail and Fakhar Zaman brought them back on the track. Both the batsmen, though, fell immediately after getting their fifties and Pakistan's innings was staring down the barrel.

That's a powerful finish by Pakistan - 33 runs in the last two overs! Take a bow, Mohammad Hafeez. Some extraordinary hitting by the experienced batsman. His 98-run partnership with Sarfraz was also very crucial as it provided the much-needed push to the dying innings.

OUT! Pinpoint yorker on middle, Hafeez keeps it out besides the pitch on the leg side and sets off. Boult is quick as lightning. Dives to his right, collects the ball, turns and aims at the bowler's end and hits the bull's eye. Hafeez was not even in the frame. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 262/8!

SIX! Oh ho! A mistimed shot has carried all the way now. This is carnage! Short ball on middle and leg, Hafeez gives it his all on the pull shot but gets a big top edge. The ball clears the fine leg fence with ease. The gentleman in orange goes for the catch but misses. Sir, you missed a chance of winning yourself 50 grands. 22 from the over already.

FOUR! Boult has lost his radar and is paying the price for it! Low full toss outside off, all Hafeez has to do is to pick the gap on the off side. He does so and drives it through covers to find the fence.

SIX! Just over the man at long off! Low full toss outside off, Hafeez lifts it over mid off. The fielder near the ropes thinks he is in with a chance. Leaps but the ball sails over him. Yes, Pakistan go past the 250-run mark. Gaining momentum nicely at the fag end.
Brilliantly bowled! Slower ball on a shortish length outside off, Hafeez is early into his pull and gets beaten.
SIX! Going, going, gone! In the zone for Hafeez, he clear his front leg and tonks it over long on for a mammoth maximum. That came right off the screws.
SIX! Bang! Good shot from Khan! On a length around off, Khan hangs back and flat-bats it over the vacant long off region for a maximum.
Slower short ball, pulled through square leg for a run.
Shadab Khan comes out to bat. Can Pakistan go past 250?

OUT! This is bowling according to the field and reaping the dividends as a result! Ali uses his feet and Southee smartly rolls his fingers on this one. The tailender goes through with his heave and doesn't get it off the meat of the bat. The ball swirls in the sky and Guptill in the deep mid-wicket region pouches it safely.
Another short ball, pulled to the leg side for a run.
Wide! Short ball but this one is too high. Hafeez misses out on the hook. Wide called for height.
Full length ball, drilled to long on for a run.
Angling into Hafeez who tries to tuck it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Southee returns for a bowl.
Sharp short ball, Ali goes for the pull but misses.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Hasan Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Smart piece of bowling from Boult brings in the reward! End of an enterprising knock from the skipper and also the 98-run stand. On a length at 111.5 kph, angling across Ahmed. He clears his front leg and goes for a hoick over mid-wicket but gets a leading edge that balloons towards backward point. Guptill stationed there is safe as houses. Boult gets his first wicket.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Yorker outside off, carved through the same region to rotate strike.
On a fullish length outside off, flayed through point to rotate strike.
FOUR! 8th ODI fifty for Ahmed! The captain has played an important knock! Full toss outside off, Ahmed slices it in the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Uses the pace of the bowler to perfection! Short and width on offer, Hafeez rises on his toes and upper cuts it over backward point to find the fence. 13 from the over.
Fullish and well outside off, steered to third man for a run.
Slower short ball, pulled behind square leg for a run.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide outside off, Sarfraz tries to reach it but fails.
SIX! Classical Ahmed! Terrific execution! Ferguson bowls a length delivery from around off, Ahmed makes room and lifts it nonchalantly over extra over for a biggie.
Driven through mid on for a run.
Brilliant yorker outside off, Ahmed can do nothing about it.
Fullish ball, hit hard to long on for a single. That brings up the 50 for Hafeez, his 34th in ODIs! It has been a good knock. Can he tee off now?

Run out chance missed! Full toss outside off, Hafeez drives it towards Taylor at point and sets off. No run is on offer and he is sent back by his skipper. Taylor aims at the striker's end but misses. Had that hit, he was out by a country mile.

SIX! Ho ho ho! What a hit. Clean as a whistle. Slower ball at 111 clicks around off, it is in the zone for Hafeez. This time he doesn't miss out. Connects with his hoick handsomely and sends it way over the mid-wicket ropes. Well, that has gone over the tree and out of the stadium as well. 105 meters, to be precise.
Hafeez missed out there! In the arc outside off, Hafeez swings across the line but misses.
Boult is back on for his final spell.
Smart cricket from Ferguson! Sees Ahmed backing away and bowls a full and fast ball outside off. Ahmed reaches out but can't connect. Only 2 from this one, Ferguson is breathing fire.
Good call by the umpire! Ahmed backs away and Ferguson follows him with a bouncer. It is going down as Sarfraz attempts the pull but gets beaten. Rightly, it is not called as a wide.
Ahmed makes room and drills the fullish ball to the cover region.
Overpitched outside off, sliced through point for a single.

Dropped! Not an easy chance though! Short ball around off, slower in pace, Ahmed goes for a full-blooded pull and hits it straight towards Ross Taylor at short mid-wicket. He leaps, gets both his hands to it but the ball pops out and falls down. A single taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Quicker in pace, cut hard but straight to the backward point fielder. Good comeback from Santner after being hit for 10 runs in his first two balls. He finishes with figures of 10-0-43-1.
Shorter in length, slapped away but finds the man at short third man this time.
Fuller in length, pushed back towards Santner.
Much slower this time, cut away with the spin through point for a single.
FOUR! Finds the same gap with precision! Juicy full toss outside off, Ahmed lines it up and smacks it to the same side of the field for a boundary.
SIX! Shot! Pakistan need to bring out such shots on a consistent basis. Tossed up outside off, Ahmed crouches and nails the slog sweep over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Hit that flat as an arrow.
Shortish delivery at 144.6 clicks outside off, Mohammad goes for a pull but gets beaten by the pace.
Fuller in length, shaping in, milked down to long on for a run.
Ferguson is a tough customer to deal with. Bangs in an accurate bouncer on off, draws evasive action from Ahmed who arches back to let it go.
He is learning the tricks quickly. Bowls the back of the hand slower one outside off, Hafeez places it through point for a run.
Hits the deck hard and bowls a length delivery at 147.1 clicks, Hafeez sits back and taps it to the off side.
Good length ball around off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Ferguson is back to have a crack at the batsmen.
Waits in the crease and dabs it with the spin to the point region. Only 3 from the over, tidy stuff from Santner.
Nervy! Fullish outside off, stays a bit low this time. Hafeez reaches out to it and inside edges it past the keeper towards fine leg. A run taken.
Ooh.. that one gripped! Floated around off, spins and bounces away sharply. Hafeez is surprised by it and gets foxed.
Fullish in length, ideal for Ahmed to sweep it through square leg to pick up a single.
Hangs back to the flatter ball and keeps it out.
Shortish delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Santner is back for a bowl.

FOUR! Almost off the gloves of the keeper! On a length, leaving Ahmed. He dabs it really late and manages to get it past the keeper to the third man fence. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. Good consolidation!
Tries to innovate but fails to execute it. Slower on a fullish length, Hafeez moves inside the line and tries to scoop but mistimes it past the keeper. A run taken.

Full marks for the commitment! Southee bowled the previous over but is giving it his all in the field. That is the way it should be. Short ball on leg stump, pulled nicely through square leg. Southee in the deep moves swiftly to his left, slides and saves a couple for his side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Another off pace delivery, this time outside off, driven nicely through covers for a brace.
Off cutter from Munro on a fullish length around the boots. Hafeez clips it to the man at mid-wicket.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now five fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Hangs back and knocks it through mid on for a run. Good over by Southee, only 4 from it.
On a length this time, Ahmed moves across his sticks, this time towards his  right and taps it to mid on for a run.
Angling substantially into Hafeez who works it to deep square leg to get off strike.
Fuller in length, angling in, played with soft hands to mid on.
Nice zip and carry on that one! Short ball, shoots off after pitching. Hafeez goes for a full-fledged hook shot but only manages to connect thin air.
Back of a length ball around off, Ahmed hops and keeps it out besides the pitch on the leg side for a swift single.
A bit of a cat and mouse game going on at the moment! Ahmed again tries to be cheeky. Moves across to his left and Munro bowls it in line of the stumps. Dabbed nicely to covers for a run.
Stays rooted to his crease and nudges it to the leg side to rotate strike.
Around the pads, Ahmed tucks it behind square on the leg side for another single at the moment. New Zealand are happy to give away the singles.
Continues to bowl the leg stump line. On a fuller length this time, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, pulled around the corner for a run.
Munro goes wider of the crease and bowls a fullish delivery from around the stumps. Ahmed has no room to work with and defends it down the track.

Time for drinks. The NZ spinners have done a commendable job in the middle overs. They dried up the runs which resulted in a few wickets. Pakistan innings is in need of a big finish now to get somewhere around 250. The experienced pair of Hafeez and Sarfraz will have to do the bulk of the scoring against the accurate death bowlers of the home team.
Good length ball around off, takes off after pitching. Ahmed has an agricultural slog at it but misses. The ball hits his thigh pad and rolls behind square on the off side. A leg bye taken.

SIX! Bang! Downtown goes Sarfraz! Gets one in the arc and swings at it with all his might. Sends it sailing over long on for a maximum. Well, it has been dropped in the crowd. We saw a terrific one-handed catch being taken in the previous game, not this time around though.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Well-disguised slower ball outside off, on a length, steered to third man for a run.
FOUR! Hit with authority! Short delivery in line of the stumps, sits up nicely for Hafeez. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb through backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, holding its line. Hafeez hangs back and defends it solidly.
Tim Southee is back on.
Slower in pace on leg stump, turned through square leg for a run. 6 singles from Munro's first over.
Innovation from Ahmed! He shuffles a long way to his left and stays leg side of the ball. Taps it with an open bat face towards point to take one.
Similar length ball, another easy single on offer as Hafeez helps his pull to the same region to rotate strike.
Munro drags his length back this time. Ample time for Ahmed to pull it through backward square leg for a run.
Fullish this time on middle and leg, clipped nicely in front of square leg for a single.
On a length in line of the stumps, knocked down to long on for a single.
Colin Munro comes into the attack.
Good length ball well outside off, steered to third man for a run.
Fuller in length on off, patted to mid off.
Around the hips, tucked to fine leg for an easy run.

FOUR! Ooh... almost a wicket! Good length ball on off, Hafeez gets his dancing shoes on and goes for a heave but ends up dragging it uppishly towards short mid-wicket. Santner dives like a goalkeeper to his left but the ball goes past him in a flash and through to the fence.
Angling in appreciably from a back of a length, kept out watchfully.
Fullish delivery around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Flighted and on middle, Sarfraz plays it off his pads to square leg. Dot ball to end his fantastic spell, 10-0-32-2! Job well done by Williamson.
Sarfraz has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Spinning down the leg side, Hafeez works it through backward square leg for a single.
Helps it off his pads towards square leg for one.
Ahmed pulls a short delivery to the deep square leg region and keeps the strike for next over.
Good length ball outside off, Ahmed cuts it to the point fielder.
Bouncer but way above the batsman's head as the umpire signals it a wide.
Back of length outside off, Hafeez guides it to the third man region to give his partner the strike.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Ahmed runs the ball to the third man area for a single.
Boult drags it short on the stumps, Hafeez pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up delivery outside off, Hafeez drives it to covers.
Trent Boult comes back into the attack.
Williamson tosses it up on off, Ahmed comes down the track and plays it to mid off. A successful over for the captain comes to an end.
Ahmed drives it to mid on.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Hafeez works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Williamson darts it on the legs, Hafeez punches it to backward square leg.
Sarfraz Ahmed comes in next.

OUT! Shoaib Malik holes out. Williamson with his second wicket. He tosses it up around middle, Malik uses his feet with the intention to send it into the stand at long on. However, the ball spins back in a touch to gather the inside half of the bat. No proper connection means it flies in the deep and gets caught by Santner. The Kiwi captain is doing it for his team with the ball.
Tossed up delivery on the leg stump, Malik tucks it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Hafeez drives it to covers.
Santner tosses it up outside off, Hafeez leans and defends it off the front foot.
Hafeez defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Malik cuts it towards the point region for a single.

Nasty blow to Malik! Oh dear, that has hit him flush on his head. Hoping he is fine. He pushes the ball towards the cover region and sets of for a run. However he is sent back by his partner. The cover fielder throws the ball towards the keeper's end but it hits Malik on the back of his head and deflects towards the third man fence for a boundary. Just to remind you he was not wearing a helmet. The medical staff is on the ground. After having a good look at him, he looks ready to bat again. Good to see. He has his helmet on now. Better. Four overthrows added to the total.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Malik pushes it to the cover region.
Hafeez turns it down to mid-wicket.
The batsman drives this through the covers and the batsmen come through for a single.
Tossed up delivery on the leg stump, Malik works it to mid-wicket.
Quick on the stumps, Malik plays it to short cover.
Hafeez pushes the ball to the cover region and gives his partner the strike.
Shoaib Malik comes in next.

OUT! Another batsman fails to convert his start. Williamson tosses this outside off, Sohail comes charging down the wicket and times his inside-out shot really well. But he would have liked to go over extra cover there. Ends up hitting it over covers and straight down to Henry Nicholls in the deep. A big wicket for the Black Caps as Sohail was looking good in the middle.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball and gets beaten by the tossed up delivery outside off.

Fifty for Haris Sohail, his 8th in ODIs! Looped up delivery, Sohail works it towards long on for a single. A well-compiled fifty for the man who has returned to the side. He will need to carry on and help his side to get a good total on board.
Darted in on the stumps by Santner, Sohail flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Hafeez drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Hafeez plays it back to the bowler.
A low full toss on the stumps, Sohail plays it to long on for a single.
Williamson loops it outside off, Sohail drives it to long off and will keep the strike for next over.
Quick on the leg stump, Hafeez flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses up delivery outside off, Sohail leans into it and gets the ball to the deep point fielder for a single.
Hafeez paddle sweeps this delivery towards the fine leg area and gives his partner the strike.
Sohail cuts a short delivery outside off towards deep point for a single.
Short outside off, Sohail dabs it to the point fielder.
Hafeez defends it off the back foot towards the mid-wicket area.
Hafeez cuts a short delivery outside off towards the point region.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Sohail drives it to long on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Santner drags it short on the stumps, Hafeez punches it to mid-wicket and gives his partner the strike.
Full on the legs, Sohail flicks it to square leg for a single.
Flatter and straighter, worked on the leg side but once again straight to the fielder at square leg.
Goes back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Hafeez has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Bang! Terrific use of the feet by Hafeez. He is down to the pitch of the ball in a flash and smashes it over mid off. One bounce into the fence.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Sohail clips it off his legs to mid-wicket and he will keep the strike for next over.
Santner loops it up on the stumps, Sohail leans into the drive and hits straight back past the bowler. They pick up couple of runs.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Sohail flicks it to leg side.
Quick on the leg stump, Sohail flicks it to square leg.
Santner darts in short outside off, Sohail goes for the cut but misses it.
Flighted on the stumps, Hafeez drives it to long off for a single.
Williamson tosses it up outside off, Sohail opens the face of the bat and runs the ball to the point region.
Williamson gives him room and Hafeez plays it through mid off for a single.
Hafeez defends a tossed up delivery showing full face of the bat.
Sohail drives it to long on to rotate strike.
Williamson drags it short outside off, Sohail cuts it behind point and the batsmen come through for a brace.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Sohail defends it off the front foot.
Hafeez comes forwards and defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Sohail drives a tossed up delivery towards long on to give the strike to his partner.
Santner darts in full on the stumps, Sohail plays it off the front foot.
Hafeez pushes it to long off for a single.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Hafeez defends it off the front foot.
Mohammad Hafeez comes in next.

OUT! Just the breakthrough the Black Caps wanted! Is that some new variation from Santner? Haven't seen that before. Oh yes, it is. A carrom ball. Santner bowls it out of nowhere. Lands it outside leg,  Zaman comes dancing down the track but fails to put any bat to it. It spins away a touch and hits the leg stump. All the pressure created by the spinners in the last 3 overs where only 8 runs came has paid rich dividends in the form of a wicket. Zaman fails to convert this into big innings!
Sohail cuts the short delivery outside off towards the point region. Tidy over.
Zaman punches it to long on for a single.
Full outside off, Zaman goes for the sweep but misses it.
Zaman pushes a tossed up delivery towards the cover region.
Sohail does the same. Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long on to give his partner the strike.
Zaman comes dancing down the track and works it to long on for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Darts it on the legs, Sohail goes for the flick but misses it. Santner appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
Sohail tries to work the full delivery towards the leg side, but gets a leading edge towards the extra cover region.
Sohail flicks a full delivery on the legs to square leg.
Quicker delivery on the legs, Sohail hits it to mid-wicket.
Santner drifts this one down the leg side, umpire signals it a wide.
Short and wide outside off, Zaman dabs it towards the point region for a single.
Williamson bowls it quick and short this time, Sohail defends it off the back foot.
Drags this one short outside off, Zaman cuts it to the point fielder and they pick up a single.
Sohail drives it to the long off region for a single.
Williamson tosses it on the stumps, Sohail defends it off the front foot.

4th ODI fifty for Fakhar Zaman. He has applied himself really well. Short outside off by Williamson as Zaman cuts this on the off side and picks up a single. This brings up his half century. He would look to convert this innings into something big.
Zaman punches it off the back foot towards the mid-wicket region.
Santner tosses it up on the pads, Sohail goes for the flick but misses it.
Santner darts it quick and full, Sohail hits it to the mid-wicket area.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Sohail flicks it to square leg.
Spinning down the leg side and the umpire calls yet another wide.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire signals it a wide.
SIX! That was a good hit by Sohail. Santner tosses it up on the stumps, Sohail gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over the long on region for a maximum.
Zaman hits a full delivery on the legs towards the deep mid-wicket area for a single.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Zaman defends it off the front foot.
Zaman gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it towards the long off fielder to end the over with a single.
Sohail leans into the drive and plays it to long off for a single.
Williamson tosses it up as Sohail hits it straight back at him.
Sohail pushes the full delivery outside off to covers.
Sohail drives it to the cover fielder.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Zaman punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks break. After a couple of early hiccups, Pakistan have recovered slowly but steadily. The current partnership is looking quite bright and good, and the tourists will hope that it carries on. The hosts would be eyeing wickets in the next half of play.
Length ball outside off, Zaman pushes it to the cover point region and he will keep the strike for the next over.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Zaman sweeps this one to square leg.
Similar kind of delivery, short on the stumps, Zaman cuts this one to the point fielder.
Zaman cuts the short ball on the stumps towards the point region.
Santner shortens his length as he sees Zaman coming down the track. He plays it straight back to the bowler.
Starts by tossing it up on the legs, Zaman plays it to square leg.
Spin from both ends as Mitchell Santner comes into the attack.
Drifting it short on middle, Sohail defends it off his back foot.
Williamson tosses it up outside off, Zaman drives it to mid off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and quicker by Williamson, Zaman cuts it straight to the point region.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Zaman plays it to mid-wicket.
Williamson starts by dragging it short, Sohail punches it to the cover region for a single.
Kane Williamson comes into bowl.
Sohail plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sohail has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish and on off, pushed to the off side.

FOUR! Classy shot! Haris Sohail has brought some calmness to the crease. Colin pitches it full and in the line of the stumps, Haris is on the front foot as he strokes it elegantly down the ground for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Zaman lets a wide delivery outside off go to the keeper.
FOUR! Full delivery outside off stump, Zaman leans into it and smashes it through the cover area for a single. What a shot by Zaman!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quick by Ferguson. He bowls it short outside off and Zaman lets that one go to the keeper.
Short ball outside off, Sohail runs the ball to the third man region for a single.
Length ball outside off, Sohail knocks it towards cover.
Sohail plays it to mid on and keeps the strike for next over.
Sohail drives the full delivery towards the mid off region.
Grandhomme bowls it short outside off, Zaman defends it off the back foot towards cover and calls his partner for a quick single.
Zaman drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Full outside off, Sohail opens the face of the bat and guides it down the third man area for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Sohail defends it towards the cover region.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Zaman cuts it straight to the point fielder. End of a speedy over!
Ferguson is steaming in. He bangs it short and Zaman does well to duck that one away.
That was quick by Ferguson. A short of a length delivery at 150.2 kph, on the body, as Zaman defends it off his back foot.
Full down the legs side, Sohail flicks it towards the square leg region for a single. 50-run partnership between Sohail and Zaman.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sohail plays it to the backward point fielder.
Sohail plays it off the front foot towards the mid on region.
Good delivery to end with. He lands it on a good length spot outside off and angles the ball away from the batsman, Zaman goes for the drive but misses it.
FOUR! Asking to be put away. Grandhomme drags it full down the legs, Zaman flicks it off his legs to get the ball past the short fine leg fielder for another boundary.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Zaman opens the face of the bat and runs the ball towards the point fielder.
Zaman gets in the line of the delivery and defends it off his front foot.
Follows it up by bowling it short on the stumps, Zaman defends it off his back foot.

FOUR! In the air but safe. Grandhomme pitches it up outside off, Zaman goes for the drive but finds the outside edge on this one. The ball was in air but it pierces the gap between the short third man and point regions for a boundary.
Colin de Grandhomme comes into the attack.
Ferguson ends the over by bowling a good length delivery outside off as Sohail decides to let that one go.
The batsman has played it to the point region.

FOUR! Ferguson bowls it short and outside off, Sohail edges that one to get the ball past the left of the slip fielder towards the third man area for a boundary. Runs are coming by quickly for the Men in Green.
Wide. The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side but misses, the umpire signals it a wide.
Good length delivery outside off, Sohail lets the ball go to the keeper.
FOUR! Half volley on the legs, Sohail sees it quickly and gets the ball past the mid-wicket region for a boundary. The visitors are converting the loose balls into runs easily.
Ferguson starts by bowling it full on the stumps, Sohail drives it to the mid on region.

We are done with the first Powerplay. The field can relax a bit with four allowed now outside the circle. New Zealand have made a bowling change. The speedster Lockie Ferguson replaces Southee in the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. 14 runs came off that over.
SIX! Boult banged it short and Zaman went for the pull. He only managed to top edge it but it flew over the keeper for a maximum. That was a good delivery by Boult though.
Back of length delivery outside off, Zaman rocks back and punches it towards the cover region and they add a couple of runs to the total.
FOUR! That was poor by Boult. He drags it full on the legs, Zaman flicks it past the square leg region for a boundary. He wouldn't miss out on loose deliveries like these.
Boult bowls a full delivery on the stumps. Zaman flicks it towards the square leg region and the batsmen pick up a brace.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Zaman defends it off the back foot.
Southee ends the over by bowling it short outside off, Zaman opens the face of the bat and plays it to the third man fielder to keep the strike for next over.
A change of pace by Southee, bowls it slower on the stumps. Zaman sees it early and defends it off the front foot.
Banged in short by Southee, Zaman goes for the pull but misses it.
Southee drops it short outside off, Sohail plays it off the back foot towards the cover region and calls his partner over for a single.
FOUR! Good cricketing shot by the batsman. A full delivery on the stumps, Sohail drives it straight back for a boundary. A glorious straight drive.
Southee lands this one on a good length spot outside off, Sohail shoulders arms to let it through.
Zaman defends it by getting behind the line of the delivery towards mid on.
Zaman leans into the drive to a full ball and plays it to the mid off region.
Boult bowls back of a length delivery outside off as Zaman rocks back and plays it off his back foot.
Boult hits the deck hard and bowls a bouncer. Zaman goes for the hook but misses it.
Sohail leans in the drive and plays it to the mid off region and calls his partner for a single.
Boult starts by bowling it full on the stumps, Sohail plays it off the front foot showing the full face of the bat.
Delivered short outside off angling away from the batsman, Zaman goes for cut but fails to get any bat to it. A good over for the visitors.
FOUR! Second one in the over. Southee follows up by bowling it full outside off, Zaman leans into the drive and hits it past the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Southee drags it a bit short outside off, Zaman defends it from the crease.
Zaman drives it to the cover region.
FOUR! Whacked by Zaman. Southee drags it short on the body, Zaman rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. A good shot by the batsman.
Southee bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Sohail opens the face of the bat and runs it down to the third man fielder to rotate the strike.
Shortish ball on the leg side, Zaman goes for the flick but it hits him high on the thigh pad.
A full length delivery on the stumps, Zaman defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Bumper. Zaman ducks under a bouncer by Boult.
Boult follows it up by bowling it full outside off, Sohail drives it straight back and calls his partner for a single.
Shortish, Sohail rocks back and defends it from the crease.

In the air but safe. Boult angles it into the batsman from a good length spot outside off. Zaman chips it towards the square leg region and Munro comes in running to his right. Puts in a dive but could not get his hands to it. A tough chance for the fielder.
Sohail plays it towards the mid on region off his back foot to end the over.

Miscommunication! Southee bangs it short to the new batsman, Sohail plays it with soft hands towards the point region and looks for a run. But his partner is hesitant. Seeing that Haris returns but then Fakhar starts looking for a run. Nothing in the end. Shows the amount of pressure they are in at the moment.
Haris Sohail comes in to bat at number 4. Big opportunity this for him to cement his place in the regular XI.

OUT! Southee has struck for the second time. Babar Azam is back in the hut. The Kiwi pacer gets some shape behind that ball. He pitches it up full outside off, Azam goes for the drive away from his body and nicks it behind to Latham who completes another easy catch. Southee is bowling his heart out in the first spell. He got some extra bounce in the first wicket and in this one, a bit of away movement worked in his favour. Top class bowling by the experienced campaigner. Pakistan are on the back foot after losing two early wickets.
That was quick by Southee. He bangs it short on the line of the stumps, Azam does well to duck that one away.
Back of a length delivery outside, Zaman punches the ball towards the cover region and calls his partner for a single.
Southee pitches it up outside off, Zaman leans into the drive and plays it to the mid off fielder.
Boult shortens his length and Azam rocks back and defends it off his back foot to end the over.
Azam offers a back foot defense to a delivery pitched short of a length outside off.
Boult drags it wide outside off, Azam tries to put some bat to it but fails to do so.
Azam hits it straight back to the bowler.
Good shot by Azam. Boult bowls it full outside off, Azam just pushes the ball in the vacant cover region and calls his partner for a couple. Good running by the batsmen.
Boult lands it on a good length area outside off, Azam gets in the line of the delivery and plays it to the cover region.
Zaman tucks the ball to the square leg region to end the over.
Southee bangs this one short, Zaman with ease lets that go to the keeper.
Azam leans into the drive and plays it in the mid off area as they sneak a single.
Babar Azam comes in next.

OUT! The experiment to open with Ashraf flops as he gets undone by the extra bounce. Southee hits the deck hard outside off on a shortish length. Ashraf goes for the cut but finds the outside edge due to the extra lift from the surface. It's easily taken behind by Tom Latham. Kane Williamson talked about the extra bounce at this venue and it's on display. Not the start the Men in Green would have hoped for!
Southee bowls an inswinging delivery on short of a good length spot, Ashraf goes for the flick but misses it. It hits him high on the pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Ashraf guides the ball towards the point fielder.
Boult drags it full down the leg, Zaman misses the flick as it hits his pads. That's the end of the over.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings. Boult pitches it up outside off, Zaman drives it towards the left of the mid off fielder to earn himself a boundary. He found the meat of the bat on this one.
Good leave by the batsman. The ball just seamed away from outside off and Zaman lets that one go to the keeper.
Zaman defends it off the front foot on a delivery landed on the good length spot.
Boult bowls it quick on the stumps, Zaman defends it off his front foot.
Shape first up for Boult. He pitches it up outside off, swinging away from the batsman. Ashraf goes for the drive and finds the outside edge. The ball runs down to the third man region for a single.
Trent Boult will bowl from the other end.
Southee lands this on the good length spot as Zaman defends it off his back foot. Good start by Tim!
Southee drops it short outside off, Zaman defends it off his back foot.
Zaman plays it with a straight bat towards the mid on fielder.
Drifting down the leg side, Zaman flicks it to the right of the square leg fielder and the batsmen come through for a brace.
Southee bowls it wide outside off stump as Zaman plays it to the cover fielder.
Straightaway movement for Southee. He pitches in a good length area shaping in towards the batsman. It hits Fakhar high on the pads.

The umpires make their way out in the middle. Ross Taylor playing his 200th ODI leads his team out in the middle. Faheem Ashraf and Fakhar Zaman will open the innings for Pakistan. Tim Southee has the first new ball in hand.
Pakistan XI - Faheem Ashraf, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Haris Sohail, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Sarfraz Ahmed(w/c), Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Hasan Ali, Rumman Raees.
New Zealand XI - Martin Guptill, Colin Munro, Kane Williamson (c), Ross Taylor, Tom Latham (wk), Henry Nicholls, Colin de Grandhomme, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, Lockie Ferguson, Trent Boult.
Toss - Pakistan win the toss and opt to bat first. They bring in Haris Sohail in place of Azhar Ali. The hosts have also made a change in their XI as Todd Astle makes way for Colin de Grandhomme.

It's all been Pakistan in the last two paragraphs and before you term me biased towards one particular team, let me tell - you seldom have something new to write about a performing team and the risk of repeating yourself is quite high. Still to prove that I'm a neutral in this clash here is a sentence on the Kiwis - After pocketing this series by delivering some dominating performances, they might look to test their bench strength and the tourists might be in with their best chance to taste some success on his tour, ohh I again brought the Pakistani angle, pardon me. But believe me, it's better for the game of cricket. Stay tuned for the toss...

It's tough being a fan of the Pakistani team and sometimes you feel sad for them. The unpredictable nature of the Men in Green doesn't allow them the confidence to back them with full confidence. This game being a day-night one is starting a little late than the last three games but it still will be early winter morning in most parts of the subcontinent but I'm sure they will be up in anticipation of a fightback. Let's hope for the same for the sake of a fair battle between bat and ball.

Series was done and dusted in the last game when a hapless Pakistan side surrendered meekly to face yet another humiliation on this tour. We're expecting a similar sort of game even today but having said that the current holders of the Champions Trophy have this habit of going against the general public notion. Keeping that in mind, let me welcome you all for the fourth ODI in Hamilton.
